note: status=noop means the method is accepted and answers success without doing anything. status=partial means it runs but documented parameters are discarded. status=conditional_noop means it silently succeeds only in some states.

Emulation.setEmulatedMedia.note: media/features are never parsed; prefers-color-scheme and print emulation do nothing.

Emulation.setFocusEmulationEnabled.note: enabled is never parsed; the page keeps its normal focus behaviour.

Emulation.setTouchEmulationEnabled.note: returns success without enabling touch; maxTouchPoints stays untouched.

Browser.setWindowBounds.note: window bounds are never applied; screenshot viewport stays as configured.

Emulation.setDefaultBackgroundColorOverr.evidence: // Nothing is painted with a background.
Emulation.setDefaultBackgroundColorOverr.note: dispatched straight to sendResult(null); the colour is dropped.

Browser.setDownloadBehavior.evidence: treat it as a success no-op rather than erroring
Browser.setDownloadBehavior.note: succeeds silently when no browser context exists yet; Playwright sends this during connect.

Storage.setCookies.evidence: Accepted and ignored, like Chrome's sameParty
Storage.setCookies.note: priority, sourceScheme, sourcePort and partitionKey are dropped when storing cookies.
